text: Power only pays when it crosses a bracket line: near 2.2G each +0.2G moves the 35% reach about three to four chapters, and 328-30 at 35% needs 4.00G.
detail: From record 003's stage table: 2.2G reaches 55% to 288-3 and 35% to 304-19; 2.4G 291-19 / 308-5; 3.0G 300-22 / 317-8; 4.0G 312-14 / 328-29. Moving from the 55% to the 75% bracket is +36% real damage for the same raw damage.

text: Stellar Link gives the largest posted steps late: opening or shaping a constellation-8 step was worth +10–13%.
detail: 1.5G → 1.7G for opening constellation 8; 2G → 2.2G for its 3-point triangle. Later constellations give more per % of area, so free players stop early ones at ~70% and spend on the newest. Points open with total cookie stars (pets don't count); shapes cost Stellar Points: ~1,900 for the 91% octagon, ~5,000–8,000 for 95% at 10 points, 150,000+ for 100%.

text: The guild is the cheapest power on record: a research-13 guild is claimed at about +20%, and leaving a guild dropped a pusher a whole bracket.
detail: Single unmeasured claim for the size; the bracket drop is a separate post. Guild help also shortens Gnome Lab timers.

text: Plating is steady but slow: to 15 costs about 414 Chocosteel and 43 Syrup per slot, and past 15 each step is a 2–14% roll with shatter risk.
detail: At 1.6G one level added ~8M and 14→15 ~20–30M. Free Chocosteel is 24 a day; Syrup comes from exchanges and the 9,900 KRW plating pack (70 + 30). Since 1.4.002 a shatter drops 2 levels and can be restored with 20–80 Syrup; the cap is 25. Every posted 4G account has weapon plates at 19–21.

text: Resolve and cookie levels are early-game power; late they barely move the number.
detail: Early a Resolve level was worth ~1,000 power and a new player more than doubled with Resolve, Stellar and gear. Late, +200 Resolve levels raised Milk's ATK ~1k where one gear line raised it 6k; levels 91–100 cost 77% of the EXP to 100. Bank coin chests and open them when a 35% line fails.

text: Free-player order at 2.2G: guild, a pure-power stage preset, the next Stellar points, Gnome Lab HP/ATK nodes, weapon plating, oven levels, Fame, then banked Resolve.
detail: The 2G → 4G player credits oven 36, research, Bari 5★ and Stellar 8-6; 4G accounts show sword 20, bow 19, Resolve 997, Fame 130, lab HP 30%.

text: Paying player order: Ad Removal and the Unique gear pack, the Crumble Pass, the 5.5 permanent membership, weekly dungeon keys, then Stellar Points; plating packs and TSSR stars last.
detail: Ad Removal and Crumble Pass are $4.99 (₩7,500) each, the weekly key set $3.99 (₩6,000). Stellar Link Pack Vol.1 is ₩32,000 for 12,000 Stellar Points. A pickup TSSR costs ~₩289,000 to 5★ and ~₩972,000 to 10★; a blessing-7 player at 3G+ said 328 would take another ~₩3,000,000.

text: Displayed power is not strength: it weights attack-type cookies and the stats you lack, so pad it for stages and ignore it elsewhere.
detail: Swapping a support for an attacker raises team power; an item's power falls once a resistance target is met; accuracy past ~1,000 adds little. Arena and Guild Conquest ignore the number.
